name: AISHELL-1: Open-Source Mandarin Speech Corpus
description: AISHELL-1 is an open-source Mandarin speech corpus released by Beijing Shell Shell Technology Co. Ltd. It contains 178 hours of 16kHz audio recorded by 400 native Mandarin speakers with varying regional accents across five domains: finance, science and technology, sports, entertainment, and news, accompanied by character-level transcriptions.

publisher.name: Beijing Shell Shell Technology Co. Ltd.

license.name: Apache License 2.0
license.notes: Corpus released under Apache 2.0 for academic and commercial use.

source_references.title: AISHELL-1: An Open-Source Mandarin Speech Corpus and a Speech Recognition Baseline

verification.notes: Verified against OpenSLR record and O-COCOSDA 2017 paper.

size.notes: Complete compressed 16-bit 16kHz WAV audio archives and transcript files.

citation.paper_title: AISHELL-1: An open-source Mandarin speech corpus and a speech recognition baseline

provenance.collection_method: Recorded in quiet indoor environments using high-fidelity microphones across 400 speakers.
provenance.curation_notes: Audio manually transcribed and inspected by professional linguists with an error rate under 0.1%.
